findings.title: WiFi Interference / Channel Congestion
findings.rootCause: Signal is strong but RTT variation is very high - co-channel interference or WiFi channel congestion (802.11 CSMA/CA)
findings.fix: Change the router channel (try 1/6/11), use the 5 GHz band, or move away from neighboring APs
findings.disproveIf: RTT variation drops below 60 ms with a strong signal.

findings.title: LAN Cable Not Connected
findings.rootCause: The Ethernet cable is not connected (wired interface down) - using the WiFi fallback
findings.fix: Connect the LAN cable if a wired connection is needed, otherwise ignore - the WiFi is healthy
findings.disproveIf: The wired interface state becomes Connected.

findings.title: Slow DNS Resolution
findings.rootCause: DNS lookup takes 500ms+ - slow/overloaded DNS server or a long query path
findings.fix: Use a faster DNS (1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8) and clear the router DNS cache
findings.disproveIf: DNS lookups complete in under 500 ms.
